display_long_description:
**Wonder is an anthology of beautiful experiments in delight and wonder.**

Discover three stunning experiences that bring magic to your everyday space. Perfect for newcomers and VR enthusiasts looking for a moment of calm wonder.

⛰️ **Ancient Ruins** - Your room transforms into a mysterious cave, its cloak of darkness torn away by a sudden unveiling of brilliant sky.

🌊 **Jellyfish Bloom** - Transform your room into a breathtaking deep-sea spectacle with a radiant ballet of bioluminescent jellyfish.

🕳️ **Parallel Worlds** - Step through reality-bending portals and experience what your world would look like if it turned into ice, dots, digital rain, and more!

➕ MORE COMING SOON!

⚠️ This is a hand-tracked 20-minute experience. Want more? Simply scan a new environment. Each new environment creates a fresh experience as each world adapts to your space.

Created by the award-winning studio, Metanaut.
